openai_yaml_schema.canonical: interface: {display_name, short_description (25-64 chars), default_prompt, icon_small, icon_large, brand_color} + policy.allow_implicit_invocation (default true) + dependencies.tools
openai_yaml_schema.note: agents/openai.yaml is a UI agent card, not a custom Codex agent definition.

literal_translation.rule: Use the runtime's native skill mechanism; if it has none, apply the skill body as inline instructions.
If the runtime has no subagents, run the steps sequentially in the main thread and parallelize only independent work.

literal_translation.pattern: Read/Write/Edit and other harness tool names
literal_translation.rule: Use your own harness tools. Treat tool names inside a skill as intent, not as literal API calls.

literal_translation.pattern: CLI literals such as /agents list, --agents, claude -p
literal_translation.rule: Use the CLI of the runtime you are actually in; do not transplant another runtime's syntax.

known_limits: Skill discovery is depth-1 by contract.
Host capability claims are not guarantees; a host that does not expose a capability is reported as BLOCKED or ADAPTER_ONLY.
The public package ships four methodology skills; everything else is discovered from the workspace or user library.
No AI host is bundled or endorsed by EOS.
